title: Immersion lithography: New opportunities for semiconductor manufacturing
version: Journal of Vacuum Science & Technology B 22(6), 3431–3438, DOI 10.1116/1.1823431, IBM Research abstract

passages.note: The IBM-led paper, coauthored with ASML engineers, names the AT1150i prototype and its 0.75 numerical aperture. The researchers report that their imaging experiment confirmed a depth-of-focus gain and describe defect challenges. The abstract does not report a numerical gain or document the dry tool’s component lineage.
